description: Query per customer inside a loop over all customers.

after.app/report.py:
from .db import session, Customer, Order


def revenue_report():
    rows = []
    for customer in session.query(Customer).all():
        orders = session.query(Order).filter(Order.customer_id == customer.id).all()
        rows.append((customer.name, sum(o.amount for o in orders)))
    return rows
